paragraphs: Self-hosted Instagram and Facebook automation on the official Meta Graph API. When someone comments a trigger keyword on your post, the app sends them a DM and optionally replies publicly. Inbound DMs are answered by Gemini. Scheduled posts publish to both platforms.
Express 5 + TypeScript + Postgres, deployed on Vercel serverless with an RTL-first Arabic dashboard at /dashboard.

Operating it: RUNBOOK.md — the procedures, symptom-first. Proving it works end to end: VERIFYING.md. Why it is shaped this way: ARCHITECTURE.md. What actually happens, hop by hop: FLOWS.md. The Carousel Studio, in depth (what a worker is, every setting, troubleshooting): docs/STUDIOGUIDE.md. TikTok, end to end: docs/TIKTOKGUIDE.md.
features: Comment → DM automation — keyword-triggered DMs via the Meta Graph API, with an optional

public reply on the comment. When Meta won't deliver the DM (the person can't receive messages from Pages), the bot replies publicly instead: the campaign's link on Facebook, "link in bio" on Instagram
Instagram and Facebook — Instagram comments/DMs and Facebook Page comments/Messenger,
Arabic-first keyword matching — Hamza variants, Teh Marbuta, Yeh, diacritics and tatweel
